Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class PrivacyService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.PrivacyService
public final class PrivacyService extends Object
Privacy front-end for the LFS/BLFS system manager, normative in system-management-contract.md §4.7. Tor is a service, so its whole lifecycle (status / start / stop / restart) is delegated to the InitSystemService §4.1 abstraction with "tor" as the service name - this class adds no tor-specific reimplementation (§6). On top of that it offers read-only views of the tor configuration ("/etc/tor/torrc") and the tor notices log ("/var/log/tor/notices.log").

Operation classes drive the UI's confirmation level:

  • PrivacyService.Operation.TOR_STATUS is read-only and runs unprivileged via ProcessRunner (§4.4: read-only probes MUST be unprivileged);
  • PrivacyService.Operation.TOR_START, PrivacyService.Operation.TOR_STOP and PrivacyService.Operation.TOR_RESTART are mutating - confirmed, then escalated via PrivilegedRunner (polkit).
The config/log views are plain file reads: they never spawn a process, never write /etc or /var/log (§6), and are bounded to the trailing 262144 bytes so a large log cannot exhaust memory. An unreadable file (tor's log is often root-only) degrades to an honest unreadable result rather than a fake empty view.

The detection, command-building, state parsing and file reading are pure / side-effect-light and unit-testable (isTorManageable(Probes), buildCommand(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.PrivacyService.Operation, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.InitSystem), parseTorState(int, java.lang.String), readFile(java.lang.String)); the live probe() and the run* helpers are thin wrappers that degrade gracefully - an absent init system or an unsupported operation yields an empty vector / a not-started result rather than throwing.

  • Method Details

    • probe

      public static PrivacyService.Probes probe()
      Live detection against this host: probes PATH for the tor binary, asks InitSystemService whether a supervisor was detected, and checks the two read-only files exist. Never spawns a process - ProcessRunner.isAvailable(java.lang.String) and InitSystemService.detect() are PATH/filesystem checks and the former is cached.

    • buildCommand

      public static List<String> buildCommand(PrivacyService.Operation op, InitSystemService.InitSystem init)
      Builds the argument vector for op by mapping it onto the matching InitSystemService.Operation and delegating to InitSystemService.buildCommand(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.InitSystem, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.Operation, java.lang.String) with "tor" as the service name (§4.1). Returns an empty list when op is null or the init system is unknown; the result never contains shell metacharacters and is meant to be handed straight to ProcessRunner / PrivilegedRunner.
      Parameters:
      op - the privacy operation
      init - the detected init system

    • parseTorState

      public static PrivacyService.TorState parseTorState(int exitCode, String output)
      Parses an init-system status tor result into a PrivacyService.TorState. Recognises the systemd (active (running) / inactive (dead)), runit (run: / down:) and openrc (status: started / status: stopped) shapes; negative phrases are matched first so "not running" never reads as running. With no usable text the exit code decides (0 = running for a status command).

    • readFile

      public static PrivacyService.FileContent readFile(String path)
      Reads a text file for a read-only view, bounded to the trailing 262144 bytes so a large log cannot exhaust memory. Pure w.r.t. the process model (spawns nothing) and never throws: a missing path yields exists=false, an unreadable one (tor's log is often root-only) yields readable=false, and a read error is reported the same way. The GUI never writes these files (§6).
      Parameters:
      path - the absolute path to read
      Returns:
      an immutable PrivacyService.FileContent; never null

    • runRead

      public static ProcessRunner.Result runRead(PrivacyService.Operation op)
      Runs a read-only operation unprivileged, delegating to InitSystemService.runRead(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.InitSystem, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.Operation, java.lang.String) (§4.1). Returns a not-started ProcessRunner.Result when the operation is mutating, unsupported, or no init system was detected.

    • runMutating

      public static PrivilegedRunner.PrivilegedResult runMutating(PrivacyService.Operation op)
      Runs a mutating operation with polkit escalation, delegating to InitSystemService.runMutating(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.InitSystem, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.Operation, java.lang.String) (§4.1). Returns an ERROR result when the operation is read-only, unsupported, or no init system was detected. The caller MUST have confirmed first.
